description:
Optional. Quote an end date, a total ceiling (including the minimum) and a per-check ceiling for a paused alert. For an alert that runs until paused, use quote_resume and resume_alert instead. Starts nothing.

Permission: monitoring:manage.

expires_at.description: UTC end date with milliseconds, for example 2026-12-01T00:00:00.000Z.

idempotency_key.description: A new random key (16–100 letters, digits, - or _) for each request. Reuse it only to retry the identical request.

maximum_charge_micros.description: Total ceiling in USD micros, including the minimum.

maximum_operation_micros.description: Ceiling per check in USD micros.

name: quote_monitoring

maximumChargeMicros.description: USD micros as an exact integer; 1,000,000 = $1. Spending ceilings are bounded to the safe integer range.

maximumOperationMicros.description: USD micros as an exact integer; 1,000,000 = $1. Spending ceilings are bounded to the safe integer range.

maximumMicros.description: USD micros as an exact integer; 1,000,000 = $1. Spending ceilings are bounded to the safe integer range.

minimumReserveMicros.description: USD micros as an exact integer; 1,000,000 = $1. Spending ceilings are bounded to the safe integer range.

providerUsageHeadroomMicros.description: USD micros as an exact integer; 1,000,000 = $1. Spending ceilings are bounded to the safe integer range.

pending_maximum_micros.description: USD micros as an exact integer; 1,000,000 = $1. Spending ceilings are bounded to the safe integer range.

provider_charge_micros.description: USD micros as an exact integer; 1,000,000 = $1. Spending ceilings are bounded to the safe integer range.

provider_remaining_micros.description: USD micros as an exact integer; 1,000,000 = $1. Spending ceilings are bounded to the safe integer range.

receipt.description: Null before approval. Final provider charges exclude the alert minimum; minimumReserveMicros is a conservative reserve, not a final charge. Unfinished operations retain their full ceiling.

title: Quote monitoring limits
